issues.description: The problem statement UML and task describe addGuestStudents(int) as a void method (no return value), but the solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This return-type mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature and cause incompatibility with tests or the specified UML contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution to implement addGuestStudents(int) as void (per the UML and task) and perform the addition without returning a value, or update the problem statement and UML to declare addGuestStudents(int): boolean (and document the meaning of the boolean). Ensure the template and tests match the chosen signature.
